task: There is a 10x-genomics single cell CellRanger data with RNA-seq and TCR-seq (contig annotations) data. There are two samples, LT5 and LN5. Load the data, perform quality control as needed. Use only the TCR data in this task. Keep cells with at least one productive alpha and one productive beta chain, and at most two productive alpha and two productive beta chains. In LT5, which V gene is most common on the primary alpha chain and which V gene is most common on the secondary alpha chain? Which sample has a higher fraction of cells using TRAV14DV4 on the primary alpha chain? Across both samples, among clonotypes whose primary beta chain uses TRBV20-1, which D gene is most common? Write the full gene name.
